title: Cooperative Membrane Recognition by Lipid-Sensing and Kinase Domains Shapes Membrane-Bound States of AKT.
authors: Nakagaki, Yuki; Mori, Toshiki; Suzuki, Kenichi G N; Yamamoto, Eiji
journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society
one_liner_zh: 该文通过全长度AKT的分子动力学模拟和单分子成像，揭示PH结构域与激酶结构域协同识别膜上PIP3的多种结合模式，属于蛋白质-膜相互作用的构象采样计算研究，方法上使用MD模拟，对象和问题均聚焦蛋白质结构相关计算，但未涉及AI方法。
abstract: The PI3K/AKT signaling pathway is triggered by the recruitment of AKT to cellular membranes. Although AKT is a multidomain serine/threonine kinase composed of an N-terminal pleckstrin homology (PH) domain and a C-terminal kinase domain (KD), how these domains cooperate to regulate AKT activation on membranes remains unclear at the molecular level. Here, using molecular dynamics simulations of full-length AKT on phosphatidylinositol (3,4,5)-trisphosphate (PIP3)-containing lipid bilayers, we identify four distinct membrane-binding modes that differ in the orientations and membrane contacts of the PH domain and KD. In addition to PIP3 binding to the PH domain, we observed specific PIP3 interactions with basic residues in the KD. In the most stable mode, PIP3 interacts with both the canonical and a secondary binding site in the PH domain, while the KD adopts an orientation in which the activation loop phosphorylation site is exposed to the solvent. The populations of these binding modes depend on the PIP3 concentration in the membrane, leading to changes in the preferred orientation of AKT. Live-cell single-molecule imaging further supports distinct but cooperative roles of the PH domain and KD in membrane recruitment: the PH domain primarily promotes membrane association, whereas the KD enhances recruitment efficiency and stabilizes longer-residence membrane-bound states. These findings suggest that AKT membrane recruitment is governed by cooperative contributions from both the PH domain and the KD, providing molecular insight into how AKT is positioned and stabilized on PIP3-containing membranes.
abstract_zh: PI3K/AKT信号通路通过AKT向细胞膜的募集而被触发。尽管AKT是一种由N端pleckstrin同源（PH）结构域和C端激酶结构域（KD）组成的多结构域丝氨酸/苏氨酸激酶，但这些结构域如何在分子水平上协同调控AKT在膜上的激活仍不清楚。在此，通过对含磷脂酰肌醇（3,4,5）-三磷酸（PIP3）脂质双层上的全长AKT进行分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟，我们识别出四种不同的膜结合模式，这些模式在PH结构域和KD的取向及膜接触方面存在差异。除了PIP3与PH结构域的结合外，我们还观察到PIP3与KD中碱性残基的特异性相互作用。在最稳定的模式中，PIP3同时与PH结构域中的经典结合位点和次级结合位点相互作用，而KD则采取一种取向，使激活环磷酸化位点暴露于溶剂中。这些结合模式的群体依赖于膜中的PIP3浓度，从而导致AKT首选取向的变化。活细胞单分子成像进一步支持PH结构域和KD在膜募集中的不同但协同的作用：PH结构域主要促进膜结合，而KD则增强募集效率并稳定更长时间的膜结合状态。这些发现表明，AKT的膜募集由PH结构域和KD的协同贡献共同调控，为理解AKT如何在含PIP3的膜上定位和稳定提供了分子层面的见解。
